purpose: Contraction of physical repository layout without loss of source, owner boundaries or tested behavior. This does not authorize product release.
abstract_dod: A0 = P AND S AND L AND I AND O AND Q AND R. No metric or evidence type compensates for another.

reticulum.acceptance: Real main and synthetic V13 are both identifiable, all 35 original semantic commits present, historical governance preserved, recoverable source and rollback.
Exactly 7 named root directories and 9 named root files on actual GitHub PR HEAD; not just a local candidate.
Every v10 file has a single mapped destination, byte drift explicit, modes preserved; no deletion hidden by a directory move.
No new broken static imports, links or workflow and manifest targets; dynamic/external consumers are UNKNOWN until independently qualified.
Original EDU and MCP owner boundaries preserved; four sensitive changes are independently reviewed, not self-certified.
Native complete suite and two product smokes PASS on exact PR HEAD; no hidden skips or stale status receipts.
CORA ENGINE run and verify evidence exist for the same HEAD, with truthful BLOCKED vs PASS; independent validation required before global promotion.

claim_status_rules.SOURCE_ONLY_PASS: Git and bounded static checks may be PASS without claiming native product equivalence.
claim_status_rules.DEBT_BLOCKED: Unqualified consumers, failed original tests, an unreadable object or a missing CORA report must hold A0 open.
claim_status_rules.GLOBAL_PASS: Requires all nodes P,S,L,I,O,Q,R independently attested on the identical PR HEAD, including native and reviewer gates.
claim_status_rules.PRODUCT_GO: Remains false; repository health does not authorize model or provider release.

mutation_design.algorithm: xorshift32 with fixed seed and 32 semantic negative classes
mutation_design.domain: bounded synthetic evidence/graph mutations, not one million physical Git changes
mutation_design.success_metric: all seeded negative claims rejected by independent expected-family oracle, with coverage and no unclassified survivors
mutation_design.stop_condition: All DoD nodes supported AND bounded saturation; neither condition alone is sufficient
